SELECT r.* FROM gkzh_zmwl_record r
ORDER BY r.record_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS finished, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' AND r.direction_code IS NOT NULL AND r.direction_code <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS chosen, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' AND r.direction_code = 'undecided' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS undecided, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' THEN r.duration_ms END), 0), 0) AS avgDurationMs FROM gkzh_zmwl_record r

SELECT r.direction_code AS directionCode, MAX(r.direction_name) AS directionName, COUNT(*) AS selectedCount FROM gkzh_zmwl_record r
AND r.status = 'finished' AND r.direction_code IS NOT NULL AND r.direction_code <> '' GROUP BY r.direction_code ORDER BY selectedCount DESC, directionCode

SELECT COALESCE(p.name, '未填写院系') AS departmentName, COUNT(*) AS participantCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS finishedCount FROM gkzh_zmwl_record r LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department d ON d.department_id = r.department_id LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department p ON p.department_id = d.parent_id
GROUP BY COALESCE(p.name, '未填写院系') ORDER BY participantCount DESC, departmentName

SELECT COALESCE(p.name, '未填写院系') AS departmentName, r.direction_code AS directionCode, MAX(r.direction_name) AS directionName, COUNT(*) AS selectedCount FROM gkzh_zmwl_record r LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department d ON d.department_id = r.department_id LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department p ON p.department_id = d.parent_id
AND r.status = 'finished' AND r.direction_code IS NOT NULL AND r.direction_code <> '' GROUP BY COALESCE(p.name, '未填写院系'), r.direction_code
SELECT * FROM gkzh_zmwl_record WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND game_type = 'zmwl' ORDER BY record_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
